verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Figma supports asset export (e.g., right-click 'Copy as SVG', individual per-layer export) and that users rely on third-party bulk-export plugins to speed up repetitive per-asset exporting, implying native export works but is manual/limited for scale. No first-party documentation in the pack describes the per-layer export panel, PNG/PDF/scale/slice presets, or batch export UI. Missing for 10: official docs on export presets, multiple scale/format settings, slice tool, and any independent corroboration of bulk/production-scale export workflows.
